title: LeadForge
subtitle: Traceable B2B sales intelligence with controlled AI workflow and human decisions.
category: Agentic AI / Revenue Ops / B2B Sales Intelligence
problem: Revenue teams lose time to manual account research, inconsistent qualification, generic outreach, and low visibility into why an AI suggested a message or priority.
solution: Traceable, review-first workflow: structured lead intake, deterministic agent collaboration, QA scoring, transparent traces, local human review, and exportable reviewed outputs without sending emails or writing to a CRM.
technicalSignals: Five-agent pipeline: Research, Qualifier, Strategist, Email Drafter, QA Evaluator
Next.js demo dashboard with lead table, detail drawer, traces, QA, and review state
FastAPI backend with health, demo pipeline, intake preview, and telemetry endpoints
Smart intake foundation: paste, CSV, Excel, and text-based PDF preview/validation
Backend-only opt-in Groq single-lead comparison path
Local browser-only human review and CSV export
Rate limits, optional demo access code, request IDs, security headers, and safe status endpoints
boundaries: No public live Groq batch automation
Synthetic/curated demo intelligence — not live company research by default
forbiddenWording: performs live web research by default
real company intelligence for synthetic demo data
